_doc: Multi-session close sequence: an ordered array of 3 close payloads, each with DISTINCT open-threads and distinct marker tokens, for the lossless-fidelity / data-loss tests. A sibling test runs runClose(fakeRoot, sessions[i]) for each in order (optionally blanking the handoff.md body between closes) and then asserts that EARLIER sessions' session-driving intent is still recoverable from PG — currently it is not, because tldr/open_threads/quick_references are written only to the handoff.md body. Each session uses a distinct session_id so cross-session corroboration / tier graduation can be reasoned about. Field shapes match readStdin ALLOWED_KEYS (handoff.js:994-999).

sessions.tldr: NS-S1-TLDR: Session 1 designed the db-seam two-dialect translation layer and chose Postgres as the default backend.
open_threads: NS-S1-THREAD-A: verify the SQLite regex-rewrite holes at handoff.js seam points
NS-S1-THREAD-B: keep Postgres the only production default; SQLite is seam-test-only
sessions.quick_references: NS-S1-REF: db-seam is a hybrid port plus regex-rewrite for PG/SQLite only, not a db-agnostic abstraction.

entities.name: db-seam
entities.description: NS-S1-ENT: two-dialect translation seam for Postgres and SQLite

sessions.tldr: NS-S2-TLDR: Session 2 shipped the stale-entry categorical fix with a prose-vs-content gate and bulk supersession.
open_threads: NS-S2-THREAD-A: confirm bulk supersession does not over-suppress pinned rows
NS-S2-THREAD-B: add the prose-vs-content overlap gate to the resume pointer pass
sessions.quick_references: NS-S2-REF: the prose-vs-content gate (P-4) distinguishes stale line-number prose from live code references.

entities.name: prose-vs-content-gate
entities.description: NS-S2-ENT: P-4 gate separating stale prose pointers from live content

assertions.subject: prose-vs-content-gate
assertions.object: shipped in the stale-entry categorical fix

sessions.tldr: NS-S3-TLDR: Session 3 repaired test-handoff.js with the marker pre-mint pattern and wired it into CI.
open_threads: NS-S3-THREAD-A: pre-mint the .claude-memory marker in setup so DB rows and lookups align on the UUID
NS-S3-THREAD-B: create the claude_memory_eval_test DB as an explicit CI step
sessions.quick_references: NS-S3-REF: ensureProjectIdentity auto-mints a UUID; pre-minting the marker at setup time prevents the 12-failure cascade.

entities.name: marker-premint
entities.description: NS-S3-ENT: pre-mint .claude-memory at setup so project_id is a stable UUID

assertions.subject: marker-premint
assertions.object: pre-mint marker before any helper invocation in tests
